description: Use when the user wants to be taught a subject, not just answered — "teach me X", "help me learn X", "help me understand X", "help me grok X", "explain how X works", "quiz me on X", "I keep bouncing off X" — where X can be anything: a historical period, a statistical method, music theory, a poem, a legal concept, a cooking technique, a library, a codebase, or a code change. Change-focused asks belong here too: "explain this diff/PR/branch", "walk me through this change", "onboarding doc for this change", "teach me what changed", "help me/my team understand this PR". Spans a quick in-chat lesson up to a saved, dated lesson artifact. Not for: a quick factual answer (just answer), needing only to see a shape or sketch (use show-me), writing a commit message (use commit-message), or reviewing code for defects (use code-review).
